author: /root/rig_identity
qualification: Private values and their digest bytes never appear in this report. Values came from the staged packets' declared transformations and retained exact originals; collider tokens came from static path matching and original/public comparison. Hash lookup covers raw UTF-8, normalized scanner path prefixes and JSON-string encodings under SHA-256, SHA-1 and MD5. Matches are exact encoded digest equality, not proof of a value's meaning or of all possible transformations. Committed older tree only, not staged work. Gzip and tar recursively inspected within stated limits; zip/zstd, other encodings and undiscovered sensitive values remain outside coverage. Whole-file hashes may coincide with a private-value digest only by equality and need separate semantic classification. No product code was executed.
